title: "Manuscript: MPX NYC Intervention Strategy"
---



```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
#| label: fig-radarsexorientation
#| fig-cap: "fig-radarsexorientation"
#| 


sexorient_labels <- c(
                      "gay" = "Gay", 
                      "bisexual" = "Bisexual", 
                      "queer" = "Queer",
                      "straight" = "Straight",
                       "something-else" = "Another\nOrientation"
                      )

  targets::tar_read(participant_data) %>%
    mutate(sexOrientation = factor(sexOrientation, names(sexorient_labels), sexorient_labels )) %>%
    group_by(sexOrientation) %>%
    summarize(count = n()) %>%
    filter(!is.na(sexOrientation)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(level = sexOrientation) %>%
    mutate(proportion = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot() + 
        ggplot2::geom_bar(aes(x = level, fill = level, y = proportion), width = 1, stat = "identity") + 
       ggplot2::theme_void() + 
          ggplot2::theme(
                          legend.position = "none", 
                          panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(size = 0.1),
                          axis.text.x = element_text(),
                          axis.text.y = element_text(),
                          axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90)
                          ) + 
          ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(
                                                dark_blue, 
                                                dark_pink, 
                                                dark_purple, 
                                                light_blue, 
                                                light_pink, 
                                                light_purple)
            ) + 
      ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous("Proportion of participants", labels = scales::percent) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.margin = margin(2,2,2,2, "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(0, 0, 2, 0, "mm")),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(0, 0, 15, 0, "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(0, 10, 0, 0, "mm")),
        plot.caption = element_text(margin = margin(15, 0, 0, 0)),
        panel.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5, "mm")
      ) +
    labs(
      title    = captions_and_titles("radarsexorientation")$title,
      subtitle = captions_and_titles("radarsexorientation")$subtitle,
      caption  = captions_and_titles("radarsexorientation")$caption
    )
```
